messages:
Ivy: dropping a quick thread about legend numbers 1: aggregate vs delta notation confusion in dashboards. users are asking whether "+2.3k" means delta over previous period or simply positive value. idea: introduce a small delta affordance (±) and an optional pill that toggles between 'value' and 'delta' display. Noah: good call. in compact legends the +/-% can be ambiguous. proposal: show value by default and a faint secondary delta under the label in smaller text when space allows. e.g., ``` Requests 1.2k +3.4% ``` where the little arrow icon indicates change. Priya: accessibility nit: screen readers should read both pieces. aria-label on the legend item should be the full sentence: "Requests: 1,200, up 3.4 percent vs previous period". also announce when user toggles to delta-only mode. Zoe: microcopy: options for delta phrasing in compact mode: "+3.4%" vs "up 3.4%" vs "+3.4 pts". I prefer "+3.4%" visually, but the aria label should use words. Ivy: touch behavior: delta pill can be tapped to cycle modes: Value -> Value + Delta -> Delta only. add a small tooltip on long-press: "Toggle metric display". keep 44px min touch target. Noah: implementation note: compute delta server-side and return display-ready fields so UI simply toggles. stable keys: series_id. avoid recomputing aggregates on hover. Priya: ARIA sketch: ```html
■ +3.4%
``` Ensure Enter toggles aria-pressed and update the aria-label string accordingly. Zoe: visual tweak: when delta-only mode is active show an accent outline on the legend row and a subtle explanatory line in the popover: "Showing change vs previous period". include a docs link "what periods are compared". design-bot: preview built for branch `legend/value-delta-toggle` 1: https://staging.redwood.run/pr/4201. unit tests include aria-label updates and toggle snapshot. Ivy: action items: 1) Noah 1 ensure server returns delta metadata and stable ids. 2) Priya 1 add aria examples + screen-reader tests. 3) Zoe 1 finalize microcopy and focus styles. I'll update the mock with the compact secondary delta and push a tiny prototype later today. :thumbsup:
